Risk_Description: Double-subtracting firn air content (FAC) by confusing BedMachine v4.1 solid ice-equivalent thickness with geometric thickness
Architectural_Impact: Understates ice mass by 5-15% and artificially distorts flotation thresholds across entire ice sheet
Mitigation_Strategy: Formally establish Variable Registry: BedMachine "thickness" is ALREADY H_ice. Do not subtract FAC. Reconstruct s_physical = s_ice + FAC for altimetry only.
Stage_4_0_1_Audit_Status: CLOSED & CORRECTED: Variable Registry strictly enforces single-interpretation definition.

Risk_Description: Solving monolithic 1.73M DOF matrix on a single desktop CPU without domain decomposition
Architectural_Impact: Runtimes explode to 16-25 hours for 5-yr runs and multi-week durations for century projections
Mitigation_Strategy: Adopt Catchment-Partitioned Domain Decomposition (Level D-Parallel): solve 6 independent catchments in parallel, reducing solve time by 10x.
Stage_4_0_1_Audit_Status: MITIGATED: Computational hierarchy established; domain decomposition mandated.

Risk_Description: Abrupt velocity-threshold switching (u < 20 m/yr) between SSA and SIA creates artificial stress jumps and non-conservative boundary errors
Architectural_Impact: Non-physical velocity oscillations along arbitrary 20 m/yr contour; violates momentum conservation
Mitigation_Strategy: Reject velocity-threshold hybrid patching. Adopt unified 2D SSA with frozen bed traction (C_bed >= 1e+08) in interior domes, supplemented by SIA flux column integral in continuity.
Stage_4_0_1_Audit_Status: CLOSED & RESOLVED: Ad-hoc switching rejected in favor of continuous frozen-bed formulation.

Risk_Description: Fixed 500 m grid step changes cause discrete numerical pinning and artificial hysteresis during grounding-line migration
Architectural_Impact: Retreat rates become grid-dependent and non-reversible under transient climate forcing
Mitigation_Strategy: Implement sub-grid flotation interpolation (SEP3) scaling basal traction by grounded cell fraction f_gr in transition cells. Verify against MISMIP+ benchmark.
Stage_4_0_1_Audit_Status: SPECIFIED: Sub-grid flotation interpolation protocol mandated for Stage 4.2 implementation.

Risk_Description: Unconstrained cell-by-cell 2D inversion leads to equifinality between bed traction C_bed, Glen rate factor A, and BedMachine thickness errors
Architectural_Impact: Fitted friction fields become non-physical artifacts that diverge during forward climate projections
Mitigation_Strategy: Freeze Glen A to standard -5 deg C value (3.5e-25); exclude unidentifiable hydrology exponents; apply Tikhonov spatial regularization with L-curve; preserve Ryder baseline.
Stage_4_0_1_Audit_Status: GOVERNANCE ENFORCED: Parameter identifiability rules strictly bound inversion degrees of freedom.

Risk_Description: Inexact Newton-Krylov solver stagnates in steep ice margins or ungrounding transitions
Architectural_Impact: Failure to satisfy momentum balance leads to unphysical velocities or solver crashes
Mitigation_Strategy: Enforce strict non-convergence protocol: backtrack line-search, adaptive timestep halving dt=dt/2, state rollback to last converged checkpoint. Zero silent acceptance.
Stage_4_0_1_Audit_Status: MANDATED: Convergence criteria strictly separate momentum residual from mass conservation.
